{# docs/_templates/sidebar/brand.html Furo's default brand renders `docstitle` as one blob — "Language Check 0.5.2 documentation" — which wraps to three lines in the sidebar and spends a line on a word the page itself makes obvious. Split it: the project name as the brand, then a meta row linking the release notes and the places the project ships from. The meta row sits outside the brand `` because it is made of links of its own, and anchors cannot nest. Icon paths: Visual Studio Code, Rust (standing in for crates.io, which has no simple-icons entry) and GitHub from simple-icons (CC0); the Open VSX logomark from EclipseFdn/open-vsx.org (EPL-2.0), cropped to the mark and recoloured to `currentColor`. #} {%- if logo_url %}
